lines.scope_summary: Perform soil testing that complies with the soil specifications provided by the tenant.
lines.verbatim_quote: Soils: Landlord shall perform soil testing in compliance with tenant provided soil specifications.

lines.scope_summary: Ensure newly planted trees have a minimum caliper and height.
lines.verbatim_quote: Trees: In no case will the caliper of newly planted trees be less than 2” and stand less than 8'-0" tall.

lines.scope_summary: Do not permit artificial turf grass, seeds, or straw on the site.
lines.verbatim_quote: Turf: No artificial turf grass, seeds, and/or straw are permitted on Tenant's site.

lines.scope_summary: Maintain a non-vegetated strip adjacent to the building facade.
lines.verbatim_quote: An 18” non-vegetated strip shall be maintained adjacent to building façade.

lines.scope_summary: Furnish and install xeriscape landscaping compliant with tenant standards and local regulations.
lines.verbatim_quote: Design: Landlord shall furnish and install xeriscape landscape in compliance with tenant provided landscape standards and local regulations.

lines.scope_summary: Permit, furnish, and install a dedicated sanitary sewer waste line into the premises.
lines.verbatim_quote: General: Permit, furnish, install 5'-0" inside of Premises at Tenant’s back of house, a labeled 4” sanitary sewer waste line dedicated for Tenant’s use.

lines.scope_summary: Hydro flush and video scope the sewer lateral up to the connection with the city sewer main.
lines.verbatim_quote: Landlord shall hydro flush and video scope Tenant's sewer lateral to connection with city sewer main.

lines.scope_summary: Provide a subsurface stormwater retention system accommodating site plans and jurisdictional requirements.
lines.verbatim_quote: System: Provide a subsurface stormwater retention system to accommodate Tenant's building configuration, site circulation, patio, site amenities, and jurisdictional requirements as defined in the Landlord's approved site plan.

lines.scope_summary: Gas Distribution scope is excluded/not applicable.
lines.verbatim_quote: N/A

lines.scope_summary: Install a gas meter or sub-meter outside the space and extend service to the back of house with shut off valve and tee.
lines.verbatim_quote: Extend service to a location 5'-0" inside of Premises at Tenant's back of house with shut off valve and tee.

lines.scope_summary: Provide a fully adhered or mechanically fastened EPDM or TPO roofing system.
lines.verbatim_quote: System: Landlord shall provide fully adhered or mechanically fastened 60 Mils (nominal thickness) EPDM or TPO roofing system.

lines.scope_summary: Ensure roof insulation meets minimum prescriptive values or a specified R-value.
lines.verbatim_quote: Insulation shall be minimum R-38 or comply with the minimum prescriptive values outlined in the IECC (International Energy Conservation Code).

lines.scope_summary: Furnish and install rooftop penetrations, curbs, and associated flashings.
lines.verbatim_quote: Penetrations: Landlord shall furnish and install rooftop penetrations, curbs, and associated flashings.

lines.scope_summary: Furnish and install a jurisdictionally approved rooftop drainage system tied to the storm water management system.
lines.verbatim_quote: Drainage: Landlord shall furnish and install jurisdictionally approved rooftop drainage to tie in with site and/or municipal storm water management system.

lines.scope_summary: Furnish and install all exterior doors, frames, windows, and/or storefront system as shown in criteria.
lines.verbatim_quote: General: Landlord shall furnish and install all exterior doors, frames, windows and/or storefront system as shown in the tenant criteria set, including and not limited to (1) primary entry door, (1) secondary entry door and (1) rear access door.

lines.scope_summary: Furnish and install a commercial grade rear service door for egress.
lines.verbatim_quote: Steel Doors: Landlord shall furnish and install [1] commercial grade 42" x 84” rear service door for egress.

lines.scope_summary: Furnish and install a fully operational drive-thru window.
lines.verbatim_quote: General: Landlord shall furnish and install fully operational Ready AccessTM Drive Thru Window.

lines.scope_summary: Provide exterior walls and interior Gypsum Wallboard demising walls.
lines.verbatim_quote: General: Landlord shall provide exterior walls and interior Gypsum Wallboard (GWB) demising walls.

lines.scope_summary: Provide GWB on the interior face of exterior walls and demising walls up to specified height.
lines.verbatim_quote: Gypsum Wallboard (GWB): Landlord shall provide GWB on interior face of exterior walls and demising walls to 10’-0” AFF.

lines.scope_summary: Deliver the space with the ceiling open to the structure.
lines.verbatim_quote: General: Landlord shall deliver Tenant’s space with ceiling open to structure.

lines.scope_summary: Install a bike rack approved by the tenant.
lines.verbatim_quote: Bike Rack: Landlord shall install Tenant approved bike rack(s).

lines.scope_summary: Permit, furnish, and install an aluminum canopy structure at the patio.
lines.verbatim_quote: General: Landlord shall permit, furnish, and install aluminum Awnex Architectural Brand canopy at Tenant’s patio.

lines.scope_summary: Permit, furnish, and install a specified fabric weather protective awning above the drive-thru window.
lines.verbatim_quote: Drive Thru Fabric Awning: Landlord shall permit, furnish, and install Starbucks specified fabric weather protective awning above drive thru window.

lines.scope_summary: Engineer, permit, furnish, and install a certified fire sprinkler system if required by code.
lines.verbatim_quote: General: If required by applicable codes; Landlord shall engineer, obtain permits, furnish and install a certified fire sprinkler system in dedicated riser room.

lines.scope_summary: Properly flash roof penetrations and extend plumbing vent pipes to terminate in the ceiling above the tenant's space.
lines.verbatim_quote: Landlord shall properly flash roof penetration and extend pipe to terminate in the ceiling above tenant's space.
